en: The Dyad on With-Initial-Mental-Consciousness (Savitakkaduka) and the Triad on the Wholesome (Kusalattika).

Dependent on a wholesome state with applied thought (*savitakkam*), a state that is neither with applied thought nor wholesome arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*)... Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on an unwholesome state with applied thought, a state that is neither with applied thought nor unwholesome arises by way of root condition... Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance. (The indeterminate root has exactly three conditions.)
